evidence.reason: build_checks now requires positive PIDs and non-empty invocation IDs on both the before and after manager snapshots before comparing them in manager_restarted, and non-empty boot IDs on both sides in boot_id_changed, so missing boundary identities (previously passing as None-vs-value mismatches) no longer prove lifecycle changes; tests were not run because the harness only exposes git commands, and CI remains the authority.
